reuse.why: The check is added to the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider's link handler funnels through, reusing its existing account lookup.

duplication.why: The account lookup is moved earlier instead of being repeated, and the closed check exists once.

placement.why: Validation sits beside the existing already-linked guard at the top of the shared link function, before any bank lookup, write or sync.

scope.why: Only the shared link function and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: Small, readable restructuring: validate first, then reuse the fetched row for the update.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, used by every provider-specific link handler (GoCardless, SimpleFIN, etc.).
